title: Turkey Friction Pot Call (4-part kit)
description: Pot-style friction call: pot body with side sound port and rebate, printed striking disc (or use a slate/glass disc), retaining ring and a two-piece striker with replaceable tip.
use: Birdwatching / hobby accessory, a fun friction-sound experiment. Use lawfully.
material: PETG for pot, ring and handle; surface disc PLA (smooth) or real slate/glass disc 60 mm; striker tip: printed peg or hardwood dowel 4.2 mm.
assembly: 1. Drop the surface disc into the pot rebate (printed disc, or a 60 mm slate/glass disc).
2. Press the retaining ring over the disc until flush with the rim (0.10 mm radial press-fit); a tiny dab of glue stops it popping out.
3. Press the striker tip into the handle socket.
4. Hold the pot in one hand, drag the tip in small circles / strokes on the disc. Chalk or fine sandpaper on the disc changes the sound.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
